method: Exact subset dynamic programming counts all ordered eight-number draws without replacement. For each subset, sum safe permutations from its one-number-smaller predecessors, excluding any lucky cumulative total. At ball 8, final low/high tails also qualify.
assumptions: The shared physical draw is modeled as uniform without replacement; no draw is generated or changed by these rules.
JP, card and multiplier are fixed in BET time before any shared ball.
A lucky cumulative total on any ball immediately and permanently qualifies JPC; low/high tails qualify only after ball 8.
The previous final-sum-only approximately 10% target does not apply to v268. Card targets and selection weights were kept while adding the requested early qualification.
These probabilities are per started Sugar Challenge. Future JPC execution/value and the cost/frequency of earning five Sugars are excluded.
Cash fractions are before per-award integer flooring. Cash is zero whenever JPC qualifies.
